system.notes:
In the darkest bogs and chilliest swamps, a blood-red cube slurps along the muddy earth. Glistening cranberry juice beads from its sides, and leathery corpses swirl around within its towering bulk.

AC 11, HP 42, ATK 1 touch +6 (1d12 + engulf) and 3 tentacle (near) +6 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 9

Peat Zombies. The cube expels 2d4 allied zombies at the start of combat.

Rubbery. Half damage from stabbing weapons.

Cranberry Juice. The first time the cube takes damage each round, all enemies in close DC 12 CON or blinded until the end of their turn.

Engulf. DC 15 STR or trapped inside cube. Touch attack auto-hits engulfed targets each round. DC 15 STR on turn to escape.

Dissolve. Living creatures inside the cube takes 1d12 damage on the cube’s turn.

Art by Yuri Perkowski-Domingos, 2023
